text:
incident-bot: SEV-2 page to @oncall-sre :eu-west-1 embedding errors spike starting 12:32 UTC — aggregated error rate 17% over 5m, latency + tail. Customers affected: AcmeCorp, FinPay. Link: https://metrics.redwood/embeds/eu-west-1 :pager:
oncall-sre: seeing the alert. kpi dashboard shows embed request failures with error 'IncompatibleModelType'. Can someone grab the routing config?
pierce: pulling routing config now. running `redwoodctl routing list --region eu-west-1 --service embeddings`
samir: I can help. I just finished the alias cleanup run for model families earlier — might be related.
pierce: output:```
alias: embed-stable -> model: chat-3q-2026-03 (variant: chat)
alias: embed-beta -> model: embed-stable-v2 (variant: embed)
```
pierce: whoops. `embed-stable` alias points to a chat variant. that explains IncompatibleModelType errors.
maya: when did that change happen? any deploy/automation around 12:25?
samir: yes, deployment 2026-03-15T12:24 UTC from release pipeline. the script that reconciles aliases had a bug that merged recent family mappings and mistakenly updated `embed-stable` to point at the newest model published (chat-3q-2026-03).
oncall-sre: how many requests routed to the wrong variant?
pierce: rough estimate from traces: ~32K requests in interval, ~18% failed -> ~5.8K failed embeddings. Affected customers: AcmeCorp (100% of their requests failed for ~8m), FinPay (~60% failures).
lina-cs: I'm in touch with AcmeCorp, they're seeing failed embedds in their search indexing job — they're pretty upset. I'll escalate.
julian: can we do an immediate mitigation? rollback alias or change fallback policy?
pierce: rollback suggested. running `redwoodctl routing set-alias embed-stable --target embed-stable-v2 --region eu-west-1 --force`
ops-bot: Command queued: set-alias embed-stable -> embed-stable-v2 (eu-west-1) by pierce. 2m ETA to propagate to edge routers.
pierce-eng-runtime: also toggle cross-variant fallback off for embeddings in runtime so that chat models aren't accepted as fallback for embed requests. patch flag: `--allow-cross-variant-fallback=false` on routing layer. I'm preparing the change.
oncall-sre: apply rollback first, then patch fallback. we want customers back ASAP and then tighten fallback.
incident-bot: change applied: alias rollback completed at 12:36:45 UTC. propagation complete to 78% of routers.
pierce: confirming: `redwoodctl routing get alias embed-stable --region eu-west-1` now shows `embed-stable -> embed-stable-v2 (variant: embed)`
maya: evidence from logs: example failure body:```
HTTP 400 IncompatibleModelType: request type=embeddings model=chat-3q-2026-03 supports types=[chat,generation]
```
no more 400s after 12:37:10 UTC from our edge logs. error rate falling.
oncall-sre: metrics: error rate dropped to 1.2% over next 5m, latency back to normal. markers: incident start 12:32, mitigation applied 12:36, stable 12:42.
lina-cs: notified AcmeCorp and FinPay with status update. AcmeCorp wants a formal incident report.
samir: root cause: release pipeline alias reconciler used the wrong model map for merge; it selected the newest artifact irrespective of variant. put a quick fix in pipeline to validate variant.family before applying.
pierce-eng-runtime: will also add a runtime guard: reject alias updates where alias type != model.variant_family (eg alias intended for embeddings can't point to chat models) — will propose in PR.
julian: assign follow-ups: (1) release pipeline validation (samir) (2) runtime guard + automated test (pierce-eng-runtime) (3) customer comms + postmortem (lina-cs) (4) add canary checks for alias updates (oncall-sre).
oncall-sre: handing off to night oncall at 20:00 UTC, leaving monitoring alerts and playbook steps in the incident thread.
incident-bot: Incident SEV-2 resolved -> reduced to SEV-3 monitoring at 12:48 UTC. Duration: 16m primary impact window.
julian: any data loss? embeddings that failed were retried by clients; Acme's batch job will re-run. no internal data lost.
lina-cs: pushing notes to customers and scheduling 1:1 with AcmeCorp tomorrow 09:00 their local time.
samir: quick mitigation committed to pipeline repo: validate alias target variant_family == alias.expected_family. PR: https://git.redwood/pipeline/pulls/332
pierce-eng-runtime: opened runtime PR for guard + unit tests: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/898. also adding a metric for cross-variant alias changes.
oncall-sre: thanks team. adding tags: fallback-policy, alias-misroute, embeddings, customer-impact. will include this thread in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Auto-note: Pager duty rotation note: @oncall-sre paged -> @oncall-sre acknowledged at 12:33, @pierce escalated, incident resolved and handed off at 12:48.
